I need to find the server-push live events mechanism in this repository. Specifically:

1. What mechanism is used to push live events to browsers (SSE, WebSockets, long-polling, etc.)?
2. Where is the "hub" implemented (the central broadcaster)?
3. Which "memo handlers" broadcast through the hub?

Search very thoroughly for:
- SSE (Server-Sent Events) or EventSource references
- WebSocket references
- Any "hub" or "broadcaster" or "pubsub" pattern
- Files related to live/real-time event pushing
- "memo" handlers that broadcast events

Look in server-side code for hub/broadcast patterns. Check for terms like "hub", "broadcast", "notify", "sse", "websocket", "event-stream", "text/event-stream", "pubsub", "subscribe", "channel", "memo".

content.text:
I now have a complete picture. Here is my report.

---

## Server-Push Live Events Mechanism

### 1. Mechanism: Server-Sent Events (SSE)

The repository uses **Server-Sent Events (SSE)** -- not WebSockets and not long-polling. The server writes `text/event-stream` responses with `data:` frames and heartbeat comments.

**Server endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/sse`
- Registered at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` (line 27)
- Content-Type set to `text/event-stream` (line 48)
- Sends an initial `: connected\n\n` SSE comment on connect (line 73)
- Sends a `: heartbeat\n\n` comment every 30 seconds to keep the connection alive (lines 100-105)
- Data events are sent as `data: <JSON>\n\n` (line 93)
- Authentication via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (line 36)

**Browser client:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts`
- Uses the standard `fetch()` API with `response.body.getReader()` to consume the SSE stream (not `EventSource`)
- Implements exponential backoff reconnection (1s initial, 2x multiplier, 30s max) (lines 12-14, 176-178)
- On reconnect, invalidates active React Query caches to resync missed events (lines 125-127)
- Exposes an `useSSEConnectionStatus()` hook for UI status display (lines 55-57)

### 2. The Hub (Central Broadcaster)

The hub is implemented in:

**`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`**

The `SSEHub` struct (line 56) is the central broadcaster. Key design:

- **Data structure:** A `sync.RWMutex`-protected `map[*SSEClient]struct{}` of connected clients (line 58)
- **`Subscribe(userID, role)`** (line 71): Creates an `SSEClient` with a buffered channel (`chan []byte`, capacity 32) and adds it to the map
- **`Unsubscribe(client)`** (line 89): Removes the client and closes its channel
- **`Broadcast(event)`** (line 115): Serializes the event to JSON, iterates all clients under a read-lock, checks visibility-based access control via `canReceive()`, and sends non-blockingly (drops events for slow clients whose buffer is full)
- **`Close()`** (line 99): Disconnects all clients (used during server shutdown)

**Visibility filtering** is built into the hub (line 134-144, `canReceive`):
- `Private` events are only delivered to the memo creator or admins
- `Public`, `Protected`, and empty-visibility events go to all clients
- Unknown visibility values are denied as a safe default

**Lifecycle:** The hub is created inside `NewAPIV1Service()` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (line 57) and stored as `APIV1Service.SSEHub` (line 36). The `Server` struct in `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` (line 38) holds a reference to it (`sseHub`) and calls `sseHub.Close()` during shutdown (line 206).

### 3. Memo Handlers That Broadcast Through the Hub

Six event types are defined (in `sse_hub.go`, lines 14-21):
- `memo.created`
- `memo.updated`
- `memo.deleted`
- `memo.comment.created`
- `reaction.upserted`
- `reaction.deleted`

The following handler methods call `s.SSEHub.Broadcast()`:

| Handler Method | File | Line | Event Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `memo_service.go` | 163 | `memo.created` (suppressed when called from `CreateMemoComment` via context) |
| `UpdateMemo` | `memo_service.go` | 513 (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo.updated` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `memo_service.go` | 585 | `memo.deleted` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `memo_service_comments.go` | 126 | `memo.comment.created` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `memo_relation_service.go` | 48 (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo.updated` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `memo_attachment_service.go` | 48 (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo.updated` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `reaction_service.go` | 106 | `reaction.upserted` |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `reaction_service.go` | 161 | `reaction.deleted` |

**Notable design detail -- SSE suppression:** When `CreateMemoComment` internally calls `CreateMemo`, it wraps the context with `withSuppressSSE()` (at `memo_service_comments.go` line 56). This prevents `CreateMemo` from emitting a `memo.created` event, so only the single `memo.comment.created` event is broadcast for a comment creation (avoiding a duplicate event).

**Helper files:**
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` -- Contains `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects()` (line 66) which is the shared broadcast+webhook path for all memo-updated scenarios
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` -- Contains `resolveSSECreatorID()` and `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent()` for constructing events with proper visibility/parent scoping

### Key Files Summary

| Purpose | Path |
|---|---|
| Hub (broadcaster) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` |
| SSE HTTP handler | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` |
| SSE event helpers | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` |
| Memo update helpers (shared broadcast) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` |
| Memo CRUD (create/delete broadcasts) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| Comment handler (comment.created broadcast) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` |
| Reaction handler (reaction broadcasts) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` |
| Attachment handler (memo.updated broadcast) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` |
| Relation handler (memo.updated broadcast) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` |
| Service struct & hub creation | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` |
| Server startup & hub lifecycle | `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` |
| Browser SSE client hook | `/bench/home/work/web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` |
| Hub unit tests | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub_test.go` |
| Integration tests (broadcast correctness) | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/sse_service_test.go` |
| Handler endpoint tests | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/test/sse_handler_test.go` |
